name: Plague Sim
description: Infect and kill as much of humanity as possible before the cure completes. The agent plays the disease, evolving traits by spending DNA points.

binding_vow.description: The agent controls a disease spreading across 71 countries. Each step it may evolve one trait (spending DNA points), devolve one it already owns for a small refund, or pass (null action). The simulation runs for up to 600 days. Maximise (infected + dead) fraction while slowing the cure.

fields.dna: DNA available to spend right now.
fields.dna_earned: Lifetime DNA granted this episode. Income is a ratchet on cumulative progress (new countries infected, infection and death milestones), not a rate, so it is bounded by the size of the world rather than by episode length.
fields.cure_progress: Cure fraction in [0, 1]. At 1.0 the episode ends as 'cured'.
fields.infected_pct: Percentage of world population currently infected.
fields.victory_progress: (infected + dead) / population, in [0, 1]. The primary metric; 1.0 is the 'infected_all' win.
fields.countries_infected: Number of the 71 countries with at least one infection.
fields.devolve_options: Trait IDs that 'devolve:<trait_id>' will accept. Evolved traits minus the one-time-use ReShuffle traits, which are locked in once bought.
fields.available_traits: Trait IDs that can be evolved right now: prereqs met and cost <= dna.
fields.action_hint: Plain-language restatement of the legal actions this turn.

observation_space.description: { day, dna, dna_earned, cure_progress, infected_pct, dead_pct, victory_progress, countries_infected, evolved_traits: string[], devolve_options: string[], available_traits: { trait_id: { name, cost, tree } }, action_hint: string }

action_space.description: A trait_id string from observation.available_traits (must be a key listed there), 'devolve:<trait_id>' for a trait_id in observation.devolve_options, or null to skip this turn and accumulate DNA.

reward.description: infected_fraction + dead_fraction * 2.0 - cure_progress * 0.5. Theoretical max ~3.0 (all dead, cure at 0%).

metrics.name: victory_progress
metrics.description: (infected + dead) / population at episode end, in [0, 1]. Primary metric: winning is reachable but rare, so agents are ranked by how close they got rather than by a mostly-constant outcome.

metrics.name: extinction_progress
metrics.description: dead / (0.95 * population), clamped to [0, 1]. Distance to the premium 'extinct' win.

action_rules: action must be a key from observation.available_traits, the string 'devolve:<trait_id>', or null.
Evolve: action is a trait_id from observation.available_traits. Ignored if invalid, prereqs unmet, or insufficient DNA.

Devolve: action is 'devolve:<trait_id>' where trait_id is in observation.devolve_options. Refunds a flat 2 DNA. Only that single trait is removed — dependent traits are NOT removed. Cure rollbacks from reshuffle traits are NOT reversed.

One-time-use traits cannot be devolved: the three GeneticReShuffle traits roll the cure back once each, and are locked in once bought so the rollback cannot be recycled. They appear in evolved_traits but never in devolve_options; a devolve action naming one is rejected.
null (or omitted) action is a valid strategy — it advances the simulation one day without spending DNA, allowing DNA to accumulate from ongoing infections and deaths.
Each step is exactly one simulation day.

info.outcome: null while running; one of cured | extinct | infected_all | died_out | timeout when done. An episode that runs the full 600 days ends as 'timeout', so a finished episode never reports null.
info.action_accepted: true if the trait was successfully evolved or devolved, false/null otherwise.
info.action_error: Present only when the action was rejected: why. The step still advances one day, so a bad action costs a turn rather than stalling the episode.
info.devolve_options: Present alongside action_error: the trait IDs a devolve action would currently accept.
info.score: Final score object (only present when done=true).

trees.transmission: Boosts infectivity and spread routes (air, water, birds, insects, animals).
trees.symptom: Raises severity/lethality; speeds up cure research.
trees.ability: Defensive: drug/climate resistance, genetic hardening, cure reshuffles.

conditions.extinct: Saturation reached with more than 95% of humanity dead — premium win.
conditions.infected_all: Saturation reached: healthy population falls to 0.1% or less of the world (~7M of 7.09B). Internal spread decays exponentially, so requiring literally zero healthy humans would make this win unreachable by construction rather than by difficulty.
conditions.died_out: infected = 0 after day 30 — disease died out.
conditions.timeout: The episode reached max_steps with no other condition met — humanity survived the window. Terminal fields are populated exactly as for any other ending.

ranking: Ranked by victory_progress desc, then dead_pct desc, then days_to_infect_50pct asc.
